purpose: Record the frozen external standard-support direction, its bounded integration purpose, version identity, and the internal support-level progression without claiming implementation or conformance.
principles: K501 remains the native information model and retains its own identifiers, sources, temporal references, and status definitions.
External standards are connected only through versioned adapters and explicitly bounded interfaces.
Original data and derived external representations remain separate.
A standard mapping does not redefine K501 identity or status semantics.
Validation is not proof of truth, source completeness, permission, or canonicality.
Unmapped, unsupported, or lossy fields must be visible and traceable.
A selected standard version is a target declaration, not an implementation or conformance claim.

standards.name: JSON Schema
standards.planned_scope: Describe and validate the structural shape and permitted value constraints of future machine-readable K501 Gateway and adapter documents.
standards.boundary: Schema validation checks conformance to a declared schema only. It does not prove that source values are true, paths exist, identifiers are authoritative, or the Library is complete.

standards.name: W3C PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
standards.planned_scope: Evaluate bounded provenance representation for source/derived entities, read and transformation activities, and responsible agents.
standards.boundary: PROV-O terms are an external representation. They do not replace K501 object identities, source-scope rules, or status definitions. Crosswalk remains OPEN.

standards.name: PREMIS Data Dictionary for Preservation Metadata
standards.planned_scope: Evaluate preservation metadata mapping for objects, preservation events, agents, and rights evidence.
standards.boundary: PREMIS preservation concepts do not replace K501 identity or canonical-state rules. Crosswalk remains OPEN.

standards.name: The BagIt File Packaging Format (V1.0)
standards.planned_scope: Evaluate package-level organization, payload manifests, tag files, and scoped fixity verification for exchange or preservation packages.
standards.boundary: A valid BagIt package proves only the requirements and payload scope checked for that bag. It does not imply Library-wide coverage, K501 semantic validity, or canonicality.

standards.name: RO-Crate
standards.planned_scope: Evaluate package-level research object description and contextual metadata for selected K501 artifacts and distributable collections.
standards.boundary: RO-Crate is not a replacement for the K501 file-level Object Identity Register, Directory Register, or DeepRead Register.

version_compatibility.rule: RO-Crate 1.3 must not be treated as included, compatible, or supported by inference from the 1.2 target.

progression.meaning: The exact external standard/version and its intended K501 integration scope are recorded in a versioned support profile.
A concrete input document or payload representation has been parsed by an identified parser in the declared version scope.
minimum_evidence: Exact input identity and byte/scope reference.

progression.meaning: The parsed representation has passed the declared syntax/schema/profile checks for the pinned standard version.
progression.limit: Validation is not proof of semantic truth, source authority, completeness, legal permission, or canonicality.

progression.meaning: An explicit, versioned mapping to or from the K501 native model is defined and applied for a declared scope.
minimum_evidence: Unmapped, unsupported, and lossy fields explicitly recorded.

progression.meaning: A concrete export or import operation has been performed and recorded through the declared adapter boundary.
minimum_evidence: Adapter/version, operation time, and transformation evidence.

progression.meaning: A bidirectional exchange cycle has passed a defined round-trip test for the exact declared fixture, fields, and invariants.
minimum_evidence: Test fixture and expected invariant set.
Observed result, losses, and validation report.
progression.limit: The result applies only to the tested scope and is not a universal semantic-equivalence or full-system conformance claim.

support_level_model.transition_rule: A level is reached only when its minimum evidence is recorded. No level is inferred from a file name, standard selection, successful parsing alone, or a later-stage claim.
support_level_model.roundtrip_rule: ROUNDTRIP_VERIFIED requires a tested bidirectional cycle. A one-way adapter may be recorded as EXPORTED or IMPORTED but is not round-trip verified.

source_basis.source_scope: Comparative research on JSON Schema 2020-12, PROV-O, PREMIS 3.0, RFC 8493 BagIt, and RO-Crate 1.2.

source_basis.source_name: User-confirmed K501 Gateway architecture freeze, anchor 1794935960.
source_basis.source_scope: Five frozen standard-support targets and frozen support-level progression.
